title: Autopay Credit for Maximum-Term Extensions under Domain Registrations
content:
A Domain Registrations domain whose auto-renew setting is on earns the maximum-term autopay credit, one of the maximum-term credits, on a maximum-term extension.

The maximum-term autopay credit is USD 0.50 for each maximum-term year where the domain's auto-renew setting is on and no declined auto-renew attempt is recorded on it less than 12 whole months before the day of the order; USD 0.20 for each maximum-term year where the setting is on and at least one such declined attempt is recorded; and nothing where auto-renew is off.

**Input, judgement, output**

```
auto-renew setting off ............................................ nothing
auto-renew setting on, no decline on this domain in the window .... USD 0.50 for each maximum-term year
auto-renew setting on, one or more declines in the window ......... USD 0.20 for each maximum-term year
```

The window is the period of less than 12 whole months before the day of the order. Hypothetically, for an order on 21 January 2029, a decline recorded on 22 January 2028 is 11 whole months back and falls inside it, while a decline recorded on 21 January 2028 is 12 whole months back and falls outside it.

Only declined auto-renew attempts recorded on this domain count. Hypothetical example: auto-renew on, no decline in the window, an extension of 7 maximum-term years: seven times USD 0.50, that is USD 3.50.
